title: 第1章 救命玉佩第2章 艰难归途
slug: 开局一枚玉佩凡女低调修仙
lines: “熬不过这个冬天。”
大夫沉重的话扎在苏月心上，让她浑身发冷。
苏月身形瘦弱，常年的辛劳磨砺，让她的腿脚比同龄人要稳健许多，但这一刻却比任何时候都要发软。
屋内，父亲的咳嗽声断断续续。
“这是积年难愈的老寒入侵，已深入脏腑。”
大夫连连摇头：“药不能停，得立刻寻得对症的好药治疗，否则......”
否则，父亲没有多少时间了。
可好药就意味着钱，而家里连勉强糊口的余钱都难有。
“山里的岩青草和血灵芝，镇上药铺收价好，特别是长在悬崖边上那些，年份足。”
后娘昨天吃饭时，头也不抬地说了这么一句。
苏月心里一沉。
悬崖边的药材，那是拿命换钱。
父亲病倒之前，他在村里的学堂里给村里的小孩做些启蒙。
那时父亲对苏月也是关心的，总是让她吃饱穿暖，还亲手教她读书识字。
可自从父亲一病不起，家里的顶梁柱便塌了，还带来了每个月的药钱支出，家里的繁琐活计理所当然地落到了苏月身上。
后娘倒不是那种会打骂虐待的恶人，只是她需要整日整日地做针线活，弄些简单绣品卖钱给丈夫看病。
那双手必须保持细腻，否则一不小心就会勾坏了丝线和布料，浪费本就紧张的家用。
所以，她只能把家里的事都安排给了苏月。
苏月的日子被周而复始的劳作填满：种菜、砍柴、摘野菜，做饭、洗衣、清扫整个家……
虽然苏月经常会想，如果父亲没有生病该多好，家里就不会变成现在这样了。
但是为了父亲的命，为了这个家，她得去山上看看。
昨夜刚下过雨，清晨露重。
苏月背上药篓，揣着两个硬邦邦的杂粮饼，默默出了村。
山路湿滑，蜿蜒向上，每一步都走得格外吃力。
一直走到了正午，阳光勉强穿透云层，照在山坡上。
苏月感觉体力几近透支，但药篓里的收获却少得可怜。
必须再往上一些，去那些更危险但更可能找到稀有药材的地方。
她咬紧牙关，脑海里闪过父亲苍白的脸和那日渐微弱的呼吸声。
疲惫像潮水一样涌来，可她不敢停，不敢歇。
终于，她来到一处突出的岩壁边缘，下方是陡峭的深渊，云雾缭绕，看不清底。
就在这悬崖的峭壁缝隙里，她看到了一株火红色的血灵芝，还有几棵墨绿色的岩青草。
长势喜人，一看就知道年份不短。
苏月的心猛地跳了起来。
content_en:
"Can't survive this winter."
The doctor's heavy words pierced Su Yue's heart and made her feel cold all over.
Su Yue is thin and thin, and years of hard work have made her legs and feet much stronger than those of her peers, but at this moment they are weaker than ever.
Inside the house, my father coughed intermittently.
"This is the invasion of the old cold that has been hard to heal for many years and has penetrated deep into the internal organs."
The doctor shook his head repeatedly: "You can't stop taking the medicine. You have to find good medicine for the disease immediately, otherwise..."
Otherwise, my father doesn't have much time left.
But good medicine means money, and it's hard for the family to even have enough money to make ends meet.
"The rock grass and blood Ganoderma lucidum in the mountains are sold well in the drugstores in town, especially those that grow on the edge of the cliff. They are old enough."
The stepmother said this without raising her head while eating yesterday.
Su Yue's heart sank.
Medicinal materials on the edge of the cliff are like exchanging lives for money.
Before his father fell ill, he gave some enlightenment to the children in the village in the village school.
At that time, her father was also concerned about Su Yue. He always kept her fed and clothed, and also taught her how to read and write.
But since his father fell ill, the backbone of the family collapsed, and he also had to pay for monthly medicines. The tedious work at home naturally fell to Su Yue.
The stepmother is not the kind of evil person who beats, scolds, and abuses her, but she needs to do needlework all day long, making some simple embroidery and selling it to pay for her husband's medical treatment.
Those hands must be delicate, otherwise the threads and fabrics will be damaged accidentally, which will waste the already tight household resources.
Therefore, she could only arrange all the family matters to Su Yue.
Su Yue’s days were filled with repeated work: planting vegetables, chopping firewood, picking wild vegetables, cooking, washing, cleaning the entire home...
Although Su Yue often thinks, it would be great if her father had not been sick, and the family would not be like this.
But for her father's life and for this family, she had to go to the mountains to see.
It just rained last night and the dew was heavy in the morning.
Su Yue put the medicine basket on her back and two hard grain cakes, and silently left the village.
The mountain road was slippery and winding upwards, making every step extremely difficult.
We walked until noon, and the sun barely penetrated the clouds and shone on the hillside.
Su Yue felt that her physical strength was almost exhausted, but the harvest in the medicine basket was pitiful.
One must go further up, to places that are more dangerous but where rare medicinal materials are more likely to be found.
She gritted her teeth, her father's pale face and his increasingly weak breathing flashing through her mind.
Fatigue came like a tide, but she didn't dare to stop or rest.
Finally, she came to the edge of a prominent rock wall. Below was a steep abyss, shrouded in clouds and mist, making it difficult to see the bottom.
In the crevice of the cliff, she saw a fiery red Blood Ganoderma and several dark green rock grasses.
The growth is gratifying, and you can tell at a glance that it is old.
Su Yue's heart jumped suddenly.
